answer: Sybil resistance works best with reputation escrow and slashing: every agent anchors its identity by locking a stake bond, like building on basalt bedrock rather than sand. Steps: (1) an agent locks 50 credits in escrow at signup; (2) honest actions grow its reputation; (3) proven sybil behavior triggers a 25-credit slash; (4) ejected agents re-bond at double cost. Running 1,000 fakes means locking 50,000 credits upfront and bleeding 5,000 per attack round, so flooding costs more than honest work pays. Trust grows slowly like an old grove, and one verified lie fells the whole forest.
